name: p4_1_a_sum_even_numbers
nat_lang_statement: Write a program with loops that computes the sum of all even numbers between 2 and 100 (inclusive).

name: p4_1_b_sum_squares
nat_lang_statement: Write a program with loops that computes the sum of all squares between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

name: p4_1_c_powers_of_two
nat_lang_statement: Write a program with loops that computes all powers of 2 from 2^0 up to 2^20.

ensures: |powers| == 21
forall i :: 0 <= i < |powers| ==> powers[i] == pow(2 as nat, i)

name: p4_1_c_powers_of_two_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a program with loops that computes all powers of 2 from 2^0 up to 2^20.

ensures: powers.Length == 21
forall i :: 0 <= i < powers.Length ==> powers[i] == pow(2 as nat, i)

name: p4_1_d_sum_odd_numbers
nat_lang_statement: Write a program with loops that computes the sum of all odd numbers between a and b (inclusive), where a and b are inputs.

dafny.method_signature: p4_1_d_sum_odd_numbers(a: int, b: int) returns (sum: int)
ensures: sum == sum_odd(a, b)  // closed formula for addition of odd numbers between a and b??

name: p4_1_e_sum_odd_digits
nat_lang_statement: Write a program with loops that computes the sum of all odd digits of a non-negative integer input. For example, if the input is 32677, the sum would be 3 + 7 + 7 = 17.

ensures: sum >= 0
sum == sum_odd_digits(n)

name: p4_2_a_min_max
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints the smallest and largest of the inputs.

dafny.method_signature: p4_2_a_min_max(inputs: seq<int>) returns (min: int, max: int)
ensures: forall x :: x in inputs ==> min <= x
forall x :: x in inputs ==> max >= x
exists x :: x in inputs && min == x
exists x :: x in inputs && max == x

name: p4_2_a_min_max_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints the smallest and largest of the inputs.

dafny.method_signature: p4_2_a_min_max_array(inputs: array<int>) returns (min: int, max: int)
ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length ==> min <= inputs[i]
forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length ==> max >= inputs[i]
exists i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length && min == inputs[i]
exists i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length && max == inputs[i]

name: p4_2_b_count_even_odd
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints the number of even and odd inputs.

dafny.method_signature: p4_2_b_count_even_odd(inputs: seq<int>) returns (even_count: nat, odd_count: nat)
ensures: even_count + odd_count == |inputs|
forall x :: x in inputs && x % 2 == 0 ==> even_count >= 1
forall x :: x in inputs && x % 2 == 1 ==> odd_count >= 1
(forall x :: x in inputs ==> x % 2 == 0) ==> odd_count == 0 // all inputs are even
(forall x :: x in inputs ==> x % 2 == 1) ==> even_count == 0 // all inputs are odd

name: p4_2_b_count_even_odd_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints the number of even and odd inputs.

dafny.method_signature: p4_2_b_count_even_odd_array(inputs: array<int>) returns (even_count: nat, odd_count: nat)
ensures: even_count + odd_count == inputs.Length
forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length && inputs[i] % 2 == 0 ==> even_count >= 1
forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length && inputs[i] % 2 == 1 ==> odd_count >= 1
(forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length ==> inputs[i] % 2 == 0) ==> odd_count == 0 // all inputs are even
(forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length ==> inputs[i] % 2 == 1) ==> even_count == 0 // all inputs are odd

name: p4_2_c_cumulative_totals
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints cumulative totals. For example, if the input is 1 7 2 9, the program should print 1 8 10 19.

ensures: |totals| == |inputs|
forall i :: 0 <= i < |inputs| ==> totals[i] == (if i == 0 then inputs[0] else totals[i - 1] + inputs[i])

name: p4_2_c_cumulative_totals_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints cumulative totals. For example, if the input is 1 7 2 9, the program should print 1 8 10 19.

ensures: totals.Length == inputs.Length
forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length ==> totals[i] == (if i == 0 then inputs[0] else totals[i - 1] + inputs[i])

name: p4_2_d_adjacent_duplicates
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints all adjacent duplicates. For example, if the input is 1 3 3 4 5 5 6 6 6 2, the program should print 3 5 6.

ensures: forall d :: d in duplicates ==> d in inputs
forall i :: 0 <= i < |inputs| - 1 && inputs[i] == inputs[i + 1] ==> inputs[i] in duplicates
forall d :: d in duplicates ==> exists i :: 0 <= i < |inputs| - 1 && inputs[i] == inputs[i + 1] && inputs[i] == d
forall d :: d in duplicates ==> exists i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |inputs| && contiguous_duplicates(inputs, i, j, d) == true

name: p4_2_d_adjacent_duplicates_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a sequence of integer inputs and prints all adjacent duplicates. For example, if the input is 1 3 3 4 5 5 6 6 6 2, the program should print 3 5 6.

ensures: forall d :: d in duplicates[..] ==> d in inputs[..]
forall i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length - 1 && inputs[i] == inputs[i + 1] ==> inputs[i] in duplicates[..]
forall d :: d in duplicates[..] ==> exists i :: 0 <= i < inputs.Length - 1 && inputs[i] == inputs[i + 1] && inputs[i] == d
forall d :: d in duplicates[..] ==> exists i, j :: 0 <= i < j < inputs.Length && contiguous_duplicates_array(inputs, i, j, d) == true

name: p4_3_a_extract_uppercase
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a line of input as a string and prints only the uppercase letters in the string.

ensures: forall c :: c in uppercase ==> 'A' <= c <= 'Z'
forall c :: c in s && 'A' <= c <= 'Z' ==> c in uppercase

name: p4_3_b_every_second_letter
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a line of input as a string and prints every second letter of the string.

ensures: |result| * 2 == |s| || |result| * 2 + 1 == |s|
forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == s[2 * i]

name: p4_3_c_replace_vowels
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a line of input as a string and prints the string with all vowels replaced by an underscore.

ensures: |result| == |s|
forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| ==> (if s[i] in ['a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U'] then result[i] == '_' else result[i] == s[i])

name: p4_3_d_count_vowels
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a line of input as a string and prints the number of vowels in the string.

ensures: count >= 0
forall c :: c in s && c in ['a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U'] ==> count >= 1

name: p4_3_e_positions_of_vowels
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a line of input as a string and prints the positions of all vowels in the string.

ensures: forall p :: p in positions ==> 0 <= p < |s| && s[p] in ['a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U']
forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| && s[i] in ['a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U'] ==> i in positions

name: p4_3_e_positions_of_vowels_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a line of input as a string and prints the positions of all vowels in the string.

ensures: forall p :: p in positions[..] ==> 0 <= p < |s| && s[p] in ['a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U']
forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| && s[i] in ['a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U'] ==> i in positions[..]

name: p4_5_analyze_floats
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a set of floating-point values, asks the user to enter the values, then prints the average of the values, the smallest of the values, the largest of the values, and the range, that is the difference between the smallest and largest.

dafny.method_signature: p4_5_analyze_floats(values: seq<real>) returns (average: real, min: real, max: real, range: real)
ensures: average == (sum(values) / |values| as real)
forall v :: v in values ==> min <= v
forall v :: v in values ==> max >= v
range == max - min
exists v :: v in values && min == v
exists v :: v in values && max == v

name: p4_5_analyze_floats_array

dafny.method_signature: p4_5_analyze_floats_array(values: array<real>) returns (average: real, min: real, max: real, range: real)
ensures: average == (sum_array(values, 0) / values.Length as real)
forall v :: v in values[..] ==> min <= v
forall v :: v in values[..] ==> max >= v
range == max - min
exists v :: v in values[..] && min == v
exists v :: v in values[..] && max == v

ensures: forall x :: x in inputs ==> min <= x
exists x :: x in inputs && min == x

name: p4_6_find_minimum_array

name: p4_7_permute_string
nat_lang_statement: Translate the pseudocode for randomly permuting the characters in a string into a Java program: read a word; repeat word.length() times; pick a random position i in the word, but not the last position; pick a random position j > i in the word; swap the letters at positions j and i; print the word.

ensures: |permuted| == |s|
forall c :: c in s ==> c in permuted
forall c :: c in permuted ==> c in s

name: p4_8_print_characters
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a word and prints each character of the word on a separate line.

ensures: |chars| == 2 * |s|
forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| ==> i % 2 == 0 ==> chars[i] == s[i / 2]

name: p4_9_reverse_string
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a word and prints the word in reverse.

ensures: |reversed| == |s|
forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| ==> reversed[i] == s[|s| - 1 - i]
